overall: All 40 source URLs resolved and every licence and may_publish claim checked out; I found no wrong 'yes, may publish', and both sides flagged CC BY-SA share-alike conditions where relevant. Differences came down to fit and credit hygiene. X's best answers (p03, p09) picked fresh, literal visual metaphors, but X several times pasted raw Commons description labels as credits (p01, p02, p10), and one licence label was off (PDM for a UK Crown expired-copyright photo). Y more often picked the most on-brief image (Village Choir, Lagos light trails, seeded loaf) with clean credits, though one of its credits was unusable (p09 Arnolfini) and a couple of its descriptions overstated what the picture shows (bread colours, Hammershoi's 'empty' left half). Both sides reused famous canonical paintings (Hobbema, Whistler, Turner, Hammershoi), which made several briefs close.
